name: Guest cart
goal: A guest adds the FBN offer (AED 95) to the cart, sees the free-delivery bar, changes quantity until free delivery applies, removes a line and is asked to sign in at checkout.
title: CHK-01 guest cart: add, quantity, free-delivery bar, remove, sign-in gate

name: Coupons
goal: An unknown coupon is refused; the public coupon RT10 (10% off, max AED 50) applies a discount line; it can be removed. The PDP 'Apply to cart' chip applies it too.
title: CHK-03 coupons: invalid refused, valid applied and removed

name: Guest cart merge on sign-in
goal: Items added as a guest move into the shopper's cart when they sign in at checkout (password sign-in).
preconditions: A shopper with a password created for this run.
title: CHK-02 guest cart merges into the account on sign-in

action: Product page → Add to cart (FBN offer, AED 95)
expected: 'Added to cart' with a View cart link; header cart count 1

action: As a guest add the seller-fulfilled offer (AED 120)
expected: In the guest cart

action: Open the cart
expected: One shipment sold by E2E Store, subtotal AED 95.00, free-delivery bar 'Spend AED 5.00 more for free delivery'
note: Spend AED 5.00 more for free delivery

action: Increase quantity to 2
expected: Subtotal AED 190.00; bar says 'You qualify for free delivery'

action: Decrease back to 1
expected: Subtotal AED 95.00 again

action: Checkout as a guest
expected: Sign-in gate 'Sign in to check out' with 'Sign in with email'

action: Add the AED 120 offer and open the cart
expected: Cart with the coupon box

action: Apply 'NOPE-123'
expected: An error under the coupon box; totals unchanged
note: That coupon code does not exist.

action: Apply 'RT10'
expected: 'RT10 applied'; Discount −AED 12.00; total AED 108.00

action: Remove the coupon
expected: Discount line gone; total back to AED 120.00

action: Back to the cart → Remove the line
expected: 'Your cart is empty'

title: CHK-01 guest cart: add, quantity, free-delivery bar, remove, sign-in gate
expected: passed

name: Card payment — success
goal: Checkout with a new address and the card method; the fake gateway captures and tokenises the card; the confirmation page shows the order, shipment and delivery-code note; the order is in the account and the card is saved as a token.
title: CHK-04 card payment success (fake gateway), confirmation, saved card

action: Cart → Checkout → sign in with password
expected: Back on /checkout signed in; the guest line is in the checkout summary

action: PDP coupon chip: 'Apply to cart'
expected: The coupon is applied to the cart from the product page

title: CHK-03 coupons: invalid refused, valid applied and removed
expected: passed

name: Card declined → retry with COD
goal: The gateway declines the card; the shopper sees 'Your payment didn't go through', the order is kept, and they retry with cash on delivery (fee shown).

action: Open the cart signed in
expected: The merged line (E2E Store, AED 120.00) is in the account cart

title: CHK-02 guest cart merges into the account on sign-in
expected: passed

goal: The gateway first reports pending: the shopper sees 'We're waiting for the payment provider'; after the gateway captures, 'Check again' shows the order placed.

action: Choose 'Credit / debit card' → Continue to review

action: Confirmation page details

action: Continue to review → Place order

expected: passed
